narrative.verdict: High turbulence. Expect outsized swings this week.
narrative.means_for_you: Expect big moves. The biggest mistake in weeks like this is panic-selling.

reality_check.line: News and the market are both showing stress — this looks real, not just noise.

narrative.nudge: In the 19 most similar past setups, sharp drops were uncommon and the market was higher a month later 63% of the time. Reacting impulsively to weeks like this has usually cost more than it saved.
